titles.title: The General
titles.tagline: He loves two things: his train and his girl.
titles.description: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer chases it deep behind enemy lines in one of the great chase comedies.
titles.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Clyde Bruckman · Starring Buster Keaton · Marion Mack

titles.title: Sherlock Jr.
titles.tagline: A projectionist dreams his way into the movies.
titles.description: A small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep on the job and walks straight into the movie on screen.
titles.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Kathryn McGuire · Joe Keaton

titles.title: Safety Last!
titles.tagline: One man. Twelve stories. No net.
titles.description: A small-town go-getter promises his sweetheart he has made it big in the city, then has to climb the outside of a skyscraper to prove it.
titles.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Mildred Davis

titles.title: The Freshman
titles.tagline: The most popular man on campus — in his own mind.
titles.description: An eager college newcomer tries to become the most popular man on campus and ends up the tackling dummy of the football team.
titles.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Jobyna Ralston

titles.title: One Week
titles.tagline: Newlyweds. A build-it-yourself house. What could go wrong?
titles.description: Newlyweds try to assemble a build-it-yourself house in seven days, not knowing a jealous rival has swapped the numbers on the boxes.
titles.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Edward F. Cline · Starring Buster Keaton · Sybil Seely

titles.title: His Girl Friday
titles.description: A fast-talking newspaper editor schemes to stop his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, from quitting and remarrying by handing her one last big story.
titles.credits: Directed by Howard Hawks · Starring Cary Grant · Rosalind Russell · Ralph Bellamy

titles.title: Nosferatu
titles.tagline: The original vampire. Still the scariest.
titles.description: A real-estate clerk travels to the Carpathians to close a sale with the reclusive Count, who then follows him home bringing plague and death.
titles.credits: Directed by F. W. Murnau · Starring Max Schreck · Gustav von Wangenheim · Greta Schröder

titles.title: The Phantom of the Opera
titles.tagline: Beneath the opera house, someone is listening.
titles.description: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars beneath the Paris Opera grooms a young singer for stardom, and will kill anyone who stands in his way.
titles.credits: Directed by Rupert Julian · Starring Lon Chaney · Mary Philbin · Norman Kerry

titles.title: Night of the Living Dead
titles.description: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in through the night.
titles.credits: Directed by George A. Romero · Starring Duane Jones · Judith O'Dea · Karl Hardman

titles.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
titles.description: A hapless florist's assistant breeds a strange plant that makes the shop famous, but it only thrives on human blood.
titles.credits: Directed by Roger Corman · Starring Jonathan Haze · Jackie Joseph · Mel Welles

titles.title: Carnival of Souls
titles.tagline: She walked away from the crash. Or did she?
titles.description: After surviving a car crash into a river, a church organist starts a new life in Utah but is stalked by a ghoulish figure and drawn to an abandoned pavilion.
titles.credits: Directed by Herk Harvey · Starring Candace Hilligoss · Sidney Berger · Frances Feist

titles.title: Metropolis
titles.tagline: The city of the future was built in 1927.
titles.description: In a towering future city split between idle rulers and underground workers, the ruler's son falls for a prophet of the workers, and an inventor builds a robot in her image.
titles.credits: Directed by Fritz Lang · Starring Brigitte Helm · Gustav Fröhlich · Alfred Abel

titles.title: A Trip to the Moon
titles.tagline: The first science-fiction film ever made.
titles.description: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the moon in a giant shell, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and escapes the moon's strange inhabitants.
titles.credits: Directed by Georges Méliès · Starring Georges Méliès · Bleuette Bernon

titles.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
titles.tagline: Young men, sold a glorious war.
titles.description: A class of German schoolboys enlists in the First World War full of patriotic fire and learns in the trenches what the war really costs.
titles.credits: Directed by Lewis Milestone · Starring Lew Ayres · Louis Wolheim · John Wray

titles.title: Man with a Movie Camera
titles.tagline: One day in the life of a city, told only in pictures.
titles.description: A cameraman roams Soviet cities from dawn to dusk in a wordless, restlessly inventive portrait of modern life and of filmmaking itself.
titles.credits: Directed by Dziga Vertov · Edited by Elizaveta Svilova · Starring Mikhail Kaufman

titles.title: Big Buck Bunny
titles.tagline: A gentle giant. Three very rude rodents.
titles.description: A gentle giant rabbit's sunny day is ruined by three bullying rodents, so he plans an elaborate cartoon revenge.
titles.credits: Directed by Sacha Goedegebure · Produced by Blender Foundation
